title: Implement OBJECT_SELECTION_SHADOW_UI_PLAN.md (selection/transform, pose-aware shadows, right-side UI, FLA round-trip)
summary: Execute the four workstreams of docs/OBJECT_SELECTION_SHADOW_UI_PLAN.md in its mandated order: baseline audit of existing partial changes (no clean checkout), failing-regression tests first, then shared transform-zone hit testing, shadow evaluation aligned to the authoritative artwork path, right-side workspace regrouping with layout migration, and finally Adobe FLA/XFL import/export fidelity. Each step preserves unrelated work in the working tree and verifies via the document's command list.

steps.description: Baseline audit: inspect current git status/diff for the partial selection, shadow, and right-side UI changes described in the doc; record per-area verified/incomplete/unverified state with files and test evidence into a note (e.g. docs/baseline_audit_<date>.md). Establish compiling baseline.
steps.verification: git status + git diff reviewed; cargo check --workspace passes on current tree.

steps.description: Add/update failing regression tests BEFORE fixes: (a) transform-gesture regressions in buzz-app tools/editor/stage test modules — corner vs pivot priority on tiny selection, pivot-on-corner draggable with adjacent rotation, rotation ring at all corners, side-handle axis, subselection shows no transform cursors, hover/draw/drag classification agreement, 100/150/200% display scaling + camera/symbol edit-in-place handle reach; (b) pose-aware shadow test in buzz-export headless_filters using a genuinely changing extended timeline: render a nonzero tween frame, assert unfiltered artwork pixels that cannot pass on background, compare silhouette vs known-offset shadow, reject both stored endpoint poses; plus mask clipping, transparent-bitmap holes, stroke-only, breathing deformation cases; (c) workspace migration tests in buzz-ui dock_columns/real_layout_migration covering untouched legacy layout and layouts customized only by tab/collapse/grouping/dimensions/floating position, idempotent across repeated loads.
steps.verification: cargo test -p buzz-app tools::tests:: --lib etc.; each new test FAILS against current code (proves it detects the fault); zero-match filters rejected.

steps.description: Implement shared transform-zone classifier: one handle-geometry module in the tool layer deriving pointer-down classification, hover cursors, drawn handles/rotation hints from the same state; screen-space logical-pixel hit areas adjusted for display scaling; project geometry through full camera + symbol placement before hit-testing and convert drag positions to edit space (handle non-invertible transforms explicitly); resolve effective pivot once per interaction (stored pivot else selection center); proximity-based corner/pivot overlap priority with deliberate-pivot-on-corner exception, identical in hover/draw/drag; Shift = proportional resize / 45° rotation snap; Alt/Option rotates around opposite corner (distinct from scaling gesture); preview and commit share one transform calculation path; one history op per drag, no-op drags create none.
steps.verification: cargo test -p buzz-app tools::tests:: --lib && cargo test -p buzz-app tools::transform_preview_tests:: --lib && cargo test -p buzz-app editor::tests:: --lib — all previously-failing gesture tests now pass; undo/redo restores original and final geometry.

steps.description: Align character drop shadows to the renderer's single authoritative artwork-evaluation path: reuse identical frame resolution (stage frame, symbol-local frame, root-synchronized instances, graphic/movie-clip timing, layer keyframe elapsed time, shape/classic tweens); traverse nested symbols with the same drawable-layer and mask rules and apply masks' actual clipping to the silhouette; apply inherited layer transforms exactly once; apply live modifiers (spring/wiggle/pose, breathing deformation) after the same world/document transforms, including warped shapes through fill/stroke/deformation handling; derive coverage from evaluated visible alpha (transparent bitmap regions, partial opacity, vector holes, stroke width/caps/joins), using an alpha mask where concatenated vector paths are insufficient; preserve culling margins, blur quality, object/layer filter scopes and preview/export parity.
files: renderer crate (shadow/filter evaluation path — exact file located at implementation start)
steps.verification: cargo test -p buzz-export --test headless_filters -- --nocapture with an actual GPU run (distinguish executed vs skipped in logs; report skips as unverified, not validated); shadow pixel/silhouette assertions pass and demonstrably fail on the old evaluation path.

steps.description: Right-side workspace redesign: default main right column order Inspector (Properties/Effects/Tool Options, expanded, Properties selected) → Layers (expanded, body capped at 180 logical px with own scroll) → Palette Color/Swatches (collapsed) → Utilities Story/Depth/Rigging/Lighting/Sound (collapsed); outer column Library/Assets/Cast tab order with Library default; contextual Tool Options without empty panels stealing tabs; consistent padding/row height/field widths, compact icon buttons/menus, collapsible advanced sections, overflow menus and labelled Library control at narrow widths. Add layout-version migration that detects an untouched legacy default only via the FULL saved layout state (positions, grouping, selected tabs, collapsed states); preserve all custom layouts (tab-only or collapse-only changes count as customized); keep Reset Layout restoring new defaults; Window menu exposes every panel.
files: crates/buzz-ui/src/ (dock/layout/workspace modules — exact files located at implementation start)
steps.verification: cargo test -p buzz-ui --test dock_columns -- --nocapture && cargo test -p buzz-ui --test real_layout_migration -- --nocapture; before/after UI screenshots at 1920x1080, 1366x768, 1280x720 and available display scalings.

steps.description: Adobe FLA/XFL large-import fidelity: (a) build a pre-conversion source inventory in buzz-import-xfl (all archive entries, scenes, library definitions incl. unused assets, instances, layer/frame counts, media refs, dependency edges) and reconcile against parsed/resolved/saved/rendered content; (b) persistent actionable diagnostics per skipped entry/missing symbol/dangling ref with reason — no partial import labelled fully successful; (c) complete media/library resolution: register all definitions before instance resolution, keep shared definitions, safe handling of escaped names/Unicode/folders/case collisions/duplicates/cycles, decode embedded bitmap/media variants preserving dimensions and alpha, implement bitmap fill matrices and text attributes; bundle dependencies in native .buzz saves. (d) Fix buzz-export/src/xfl/mod.rs solid helper to emit gradient and bitmap paints; address reported losses (tweens, sound, filters, inverse masks); keep the distinction between native document (.buzz per buzz-doc/format.rs) and Adobe-compatible export artifacts.
steps.verification: Round-trip/import tests on a representative failing FLA (compressed + unpacked XFL, original preserved): inventory-vs-rendered reconciliation test passes; gradient/bitmap paint export assertions pass.

steps.description: Full validation and reporting: run the doc's exact command list (cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo check --workspace; buzz-app tools/transform_preview/editor/stage/dock_geometry tests; buzz-ui lib + dock_columns + real_layout_migration; buzz-export headless_filters; cargo test --workspace). Record each command, outcome and executed test count against the final revision; keep GPU-executed/skipped/ignored/failed distinct; capture before/after UI images and animated pose/shadow comparison; report changed files, test commands, screenshots, remaining limitations.
steps.verification: All listed commands pass (or baseline failures reported separately); evidence artifacts saved.

risks: Working tree contains partial changes from earlier interrupted attempts; must preserve them and avoid assuming a clean checkout.
Shadow acceptance requires an actual GPU run; without one the item remains unverified rather than passing nominally.
No failing customer FLA has been reproduced yet — import fidelity work may be blocked pending a representative file.
Display-scaling (150/200%) verification may not be fully achievable headless and must be recorded as such.
Scope spans four subsystems; a regression in one area can invalidate earlier passing evidence, so the broader workspace suite may need re-runs.
questions: Is a representative failing FLA file available to use for step 6 (the doc requires obtaining one and preserves the original)?
Will an actual GPU run be possible on this machine for the shadow acceptance tests, or should that item stay explicitly unverified?
Given the four workstreams' size, confirm proceeding through all of them in a single implementation pass as authorized.
